plan: Define an immutable initial-session template dict (active=False, contact_confirmed=None, appointment_id=None, completed=False) and copy it for construction, begin, and abandon so resets are always exact.
Copy the appointments into private per-entry dicts at construction and precompute the set of known ids for O(1) validation of choices and corrections.

Centralize screen creation in a single _screen(prompt, messages) factory that returns exactly {prompt, messages, choices} and populates choices (fresh {id, label} dicts in input order) if and only if the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Route handle() through a string-keyed dispatch table of per-action handlers, guarding non-dict actions and non-string/unknown types with an error screen instead of an exception.

Give every handler a strict validate-then-commit shape: all precondition and payload checks (session state, bool/str types, known ids) run before any session mutation, so rejected actions provably leave accepted data untouched.
Implement error screens via one _error(reason) helper that emits a first message beginning 'Error:' with a neutral 'Error' prompt and empty choices.

Derive post-correction prompts from a _next_prompt() function that returns the first unmet step (Confirm contact, then Choose appointment, then Review and complete); other handlers return their contract-fixed prompts and messages directly.
Implement run_once() to raise RuntimeError before touching either collaborator when one is missing, then read_action(), handle(), display() exactly once, and return the identical screen object.

Verify the contract with a quick mental walkthrough: begin-only-when-inactive, contact/choice/correct require active+incomplete, complete requires confirmed contact plus a selection and flips completed/inactive, abandon requires active and restores the initial session.
mechanisms: Initial-session template constant copied for construction, begin, and abandon resets
Constructor-injected action_source/screen_sink collaborators enabling standard-library unittest fakes
Defensive copy of appointments plus precomputed known-id set for validation
Single screen factory enforcing the exact {prompt, messages, choices} shape and prompt-conditional choices
String-keyed dispatch table in handle() with malformed-action guards
Validate-then-commit handlers ensuring invalid actions never mutate session state
Uniform _error helper producing 'Error:'-prefixed first messages without raising
Fail-fast RuntimeError guard in run_once() before either collaborator is invoked
